title: No source names a contact-repository operation, its path, its body or its status codes
source: Legacy RWB-E4-039 endpoints table; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.18; TSD P6 Communications v2 appendix T-A.1; Ownership Map v1
section: 7 Acceptance criteria; 11 Data; 12.1 REST operations provided; 16 Test cases
description: The legacy story serves FEAT-COM-05 through the two notice endpoints POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/notices and GET /api/recovery/v1/notices/{noticeId}, which generate and read a notice and maintain no consent state. The TSD P6 endpoint inventory stops at API-P6-011 and holds no contact operation, the Ownership Map REST row of P6 lists the same eleven operations, and neither the FSD A2.18 flow nor the legacy story names a contact path. The three contact operations of this key, their requests, their answers, their six error responses and the field lengths and paging of the list are therefore fixed by RWB-P6-E4039-CON and named in no source.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Endpoints table rows POST /api/recovery/v1/cases/{caseId}/notices and GET /api/recovery/v1/notices/{noticeId}; TSD P6 v2 T-A.1 rows API-P6-001 to API-P6-011 with no contact row; FSD P6 v3 A2.18.2 steps 1 to 3 name a screen action and no operation
proposed: Fix the three operations in RWB-P6-E4039-CON under /api/recovery/comms/v1 as GET /parties/{partyId}/contacts, PUT /contacts/{contactKey}/consent and POST /contacts/{contactKey}/verification, with the ten-element contact answer, the closed consent set of GIVEN and WITHDRAWN, and the six error responses; mark each operation in the document as fixed by the baseline.

title: The legacy data table gives contact_point_ext to the P6 module while the Ownership Map gives it to P1 rwb-source-data
source: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Data table; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.18.2; Ownership Map v1; P6 context pack ownership rows
section: 2 Business rationale; 11 Data; 12.7 Tables owned; 13 Solution plan; 18 Traceability
description: The legacy story lists contact_point_ext with DF-EXT-013 to DF-EXT-026 as a module P6 row and the FSD P6 A2.18.2 says consent, verification and failed count are held in recovery.contact_point_ext, keyed by the composite contact key. The Ownership Map carries contact_point_ext under P1 rwb_source_data with party_ext, account_ext and valuation_ext, and the P6 ownership row names only merge_field, notice and template. The feature FEAT-COM-05 stays with P6, so the owner of the feature and the owner of the row are different services and no source reconciles them.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Data table row contact_point_ext DF-EXT-013 to DF-EXT-026; FSD P6 v3 A2.18.2 'consent, verification and failed count are held in recovery.contact_point_ext'; Ownership Map v1 row contact_point_ext = P1, rwb_source_data
proposed: Keep FEAT-COM-05 with P6 and record contact_point_ext as P1's row in rwb_source_data: rwb-comms owns the two operations, the consent rule, the decision record and the panel answer, reads and writes the contact facts on the rwb-source-data contract one hop, and declares no contact table, no contact column and no ACE view of its own.

title: The rwb-source-data contact operations have no published path, body or status code and no C row in this key's plan
source: Ownership Map v1; RWB-P6-E4039 Work Package dependency rows; FSD P1 Recovery data engine v3 change note; DP-05 of Template and Rules v1
section: 3 Preconditions; 5 Exception paths; 11 Data; 12.2 REST operations consumed; 12.8 Contract fakes
description: DP-05 sends the contact facts to the rwb-source-data contract, and the ownership rows show contact_point_ext, party_ext and the views v_ace_customer and v_ace_contact as P1's. No source names the P1 operation that reads the contact points of a party, the operations that write consent and verification, their bodies or their status codes, and the Work Package declares no C row for a P1 contract story on either story of this key. The consumer therefore has to build against a placeholder and a fake.
evidence: Work Package story rows with Contract dependencies, Integration dependencies and External dependencies empty; TSD P1 v3 T3.1 names contact_point_ext as an extension table and no contact operation; Ownership Map v1 P1 row
proposed: Declare the three P1 operations and the P7 rule-version read as consumed and faked, carry the placeholder on their paths, bodies and status codes in 12.2 and 12.8, and ask the P1 and P7 contract owners to publish them before the integration stage; no dependency row is edited.

title: No source names a screen for the contact repository and the legacy screen is the template screen
source: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Screen and states table; FSD P6 Communications v3 Screens list; TSD P6 Communications v2 T-A.1
section: 1 Story; 15 Screens and states; 19 Out of scope
description: The legacy story names SCR-33 Template approval with the states Draft, approved and withdrawn for a feature that keeps consent and verification of contact points, and the FSD P6 screens list holds SCR-33 only. Neither source names the panel on which a compliance and PDPA officer maintains a consent state, its identifier, its field list or its masking, and the legacy screen cannot show a consent state of a contact point.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Screen and states table row SCR-33 Template approval; FSD P6 v3 Screens table with the single row SCR-33 Template approval
proposed: Serve the contact panel of a party through the gateway-bff composite route of RWB-PLT-N001-CON and leave the screen identifier, its field list and its masking to the story that owns the case record view and to the edge contract; keep SCR-33 with the template stories of the same service.

title: The module specification states no consent-state list and no consent-evidence rule, and the catalogue holds no contact event
source: FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.18.3.1 and A2.18.3.2; TSD P6 Communications v2 T3.2; Event and Messaging Design v4 sheet Events; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-UNI-10
section: 7 Acceptance criteria AC3, AC4 and AC5; 9 State transitions; 12.3 Events published
description: The values GIVEN and WITHDRAWN appear only in the acceptance criteria of other P6 features (AC-P6-003-01 and AC-EXC-P6-003-01) and the list-of-values table of TSD P6 T3.2 holds no consent list, while the field catalogue of FSD P6 A2.18 lists notice fields and not contact fields. R-UNI-10 states that a withdrawn consent removes the channel and keeps the statutory notices, and states no rule on the evidence for reinstating a channel, on a second consent, or on which roles may record one. The event catalogue holds EV-13, EV-14 and EV-15 for notices and no contact event, so a consent change of this service announces nothing to any consumer.
evidence: TSD P6 v2 T3.2 lists LOV-CHANNEL, LOV-DELIVERY, LOV-LANG, LOV-NOTICE, LOV-PRODUCT, LOV-SENT-TYPE, LOV-SIGN-METHOD, LOV-SIGN-STATUS and LOV-SIGNATURE-BASIS and no consent list; FSD P6 v3 A2.18.3.2 field catalogue rows notice.*; Event and Messaging Design v4 EV-13 to EV-15 only
proposed: Fix the consent set as the closed GIVEN and WITHDRAWN in RWB-P6-E4039-CON as data with a version, require only that the P1 owner accepts the write and that the decision record exists before a state changes, and declare no contact event of this service; the evidence and the roles are the PDPA office's to confirm.

title: The legacy story declares Litigation C and R while the module matrix gives the primary role Documents RU
source: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Permission checks table; FSD P6 Communications v3 A2.18.3.3; TSD P6 Communications v2 T6.1
section: 10 Authority; 12.1 REST operations provided; 14 Validation and messages
description: The legacy story declares capability area Litigation with right C for POST /cases/{caseId}/notices and right R for GET /notices/{noticeId}, held by RW-LITOFF and RW-ENFORCE for C and by a long role list for R, and those are the rights of the notice operations. The FSD A2.18.3.3 names the compliance and PDPA officer as primary and the case owner as also-user, and TSD P6 T6.1 gives RW-COMPLY Documents RU and Litigation R. The contact operations of this key are none of the legacy three, so the legacy capability area and right cannot be carried over and no source states the right of a contact write under Documents.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-039 Permission checks row Litigation C for RW-LITOFF and RW-ENFORCE and Litigation R for RW-CASEOWN and others; TSD P6 v2 T6.1 row RW-COMPLY Documents RU, Litigation R
proposed: Declare capability area Documents with right R for the contact read and right U for the two writes with the scope applied, per the Documents rights of RW-COMPLY and RW-CASEOWN in TSD P6 T6.1; keep the legacy Litigation C and R rows as the legacy claim of the notice operations and leave them with the notice stories of this service.
